title: Station Cash bonus game card promotion
names_seen: Station Cash bonus game card promotion

facts.statement: The Station Cash bonus promotion ran from 12:01 AM PDT on 6/8/2012 to 11:59 PM PDT on 6/10/2012, with cards redeemable in-game or at soe.com/gamecards.
facts.quote: Redeem between 12:01 AM PDT 6/8/2012 and 11:59 PM PDT 6/10/2012

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A freerealms.com news post announcing a weekend promotion: redeeming an SOE Pre-Paid Game Card in the window June 8-10, 2012 grants a 500 Station Cash bonus. The page gives no patch or gameplay details. The post's exact date is not shown; it was captured 2012-06-10 and said it was posted 5 days earlier.
